lead.headline: Tuten likely out tonight; start Kamara now
lead.deck: No practice all week and a 27-for-27 history; Wilson still in the concussion protocol; Murray a coin flip for Monday.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday, and every one of the 27 players in Liam Coen's Jacksonville tenure who missed a full week also missed the game. He plays at Baltimore at 19:15 tonight and locks at kickoff, so the safe default is Kamara in his slot now, with Tuten restored only if he is on the 17:45 active list. Garrett Wilson remains in the concussion protocol after a Wednesday DNP; if he is not cleared, Diggs moves to WR and Allgeier takes the FLEX, because Metcalf is on bye. Kyler Murray's hamstring is a coin flip for Monday night. No insider had ruled on Tuten by 15:00Z, and the Jacksonville total has fallen to 39.5. Nothing on the wire clears the bar.
